name: @pipeworx/mcp-visualcrossing

tools.name: weather_timeline
tools.description: Get daily weather for a location — works for BOTH historical weather (past dates) and forecast (future or no dates). Use this for HISTORICAL weather and "weather on a past date" questions, e.g. "what was the weather in Paris on 2023-07-04" (location: "Paris", start_date: "2023-07-04"). Pass start_date alone for a single day, or start_date + end_date for a range (weather timeline). Returns per-day temp/min/max, humidity, precipitation, wind, and conditions. Example: weather_timeline({ location: "London", start_date: "2024-01-01", end_date: "2024-01-07" }).

start_date.description: Optional start date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Past dates return HISTORICAL weather; future dates return forecast. Omit for the default 15-day forecast.

end_date.description: Optional end date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Only used when start_date is also given; produces a date-range timeline.

units.description: Unit group: "metric" (°C, km/h — default), "us" (°F, mph), or "uk".

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Visual Crossing API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

tools.name: current_conditions
tools.description: Get the live CURRENT weather conditions right now for a location — temperature, feels-like, humidity, wind, and conditions. Example: current_conditions({ location: "Tokyo" }).

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Visual Crossing API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

tools.name: forecast
tools.description: Get the upcoming 15-day daily weather FORECAST for a location — per-day temp/min/max, humidity, precipitation chance, wind, and conditions. Example: forecast({ location: "Berlin" }).

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Visual Crossing API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-visualcrossing forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the visualcrossing pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
